title: Ravenwood Film Festival
summary: Key art and an event poster for a weekend of horror, sci-fi and thriller films in Sault Ste. Marie.
overview: Ravenwood is a genre film festival at The Queen of Hearts Club in Sault Ste. Marie. We made two pieces for it: a moody key art for the festival's identity, and a playful retro poster to promote the October 26–28 weekend.

cover.alt: Ravenwood Film Festival key art: a raven's silhouette filled with misty pine forest, a strip of film leader and a glowing projector

challenge.heading: The brief
body: The festival needed an image to represent it, and a poster that would get people to come out for the weekend. Those were different enough jobs that we made two pieces.

idea.heading: The approach
body: The key art uses a raven filled with misty pine forest, with a strip of film leader and a small projector. It's used on the website and on screen at the festival.
The poster takes its cue from old drive-in horror one-sheets — torn paper, a camera-headed waitress serving a tentacled monster, big yellow type — with the dates, venue and website kept easy to read.

execution.heading: What we delivered
body: Key art and logo lockup, a print poster, and versions of both for social and the website.
